competencies.name: Agency

competencies.definition: Noticing what needs to happen before being told

competencies.name: Judgement
competencies.definition: Choosing well when several answers are defensible

competencies.name: Resourcefulness
competencies.definition: Finding your own way to the information

competencies.name: Communication
